summary: Cancel Order feature testing COMPLETE - All 10 backend tests passed, all frontend UI features verified. Feature includes: cancelled status, confirmation dialog with reason textarea, read-only cancelled orders with red styling, status filter includes Cancelled, summary card shows cancelled count, edit button hidden for cancelled orders.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> - cosmetic issue inherited from previous features, does not affect functionality

passed_tests: Backend: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status with status=cancelled and cancellation_reason - sets status, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason
Backend: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status with status=cancelled without reason - works correctly
Backend: Admin can revert cancelled order back to pending (clears cancelled_at/cancellation_reason)
Backend: Non-admin cannot modify cancelled order status (returns 400)
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{id} on cancelled order returns 400 'Cancelled orders cannot be edited'
Backend: GET /api/orders/summary/stats includes total_cancelled field
Backend: GET /api/orders returns cancelled_at and cancellation_reason fields
Backend: GET /api/orders?status=cancelled filters cancelled orders only
Backend: Invalid status returns 400
Backend: Admin can cancel delivered order
Frontend: Cancelled summary card (red) visible with XCircle icon
Frontend: Status dropdown shows Pending/Delivered/Cancel Order options
Frontend: Clicking 'Cancel Order' opens confirmation dialog with reason textarea
Frontend: Cancel dialog shows warning message about excluding from sales data
Frontend: Confirming cancellation changes order status to cancelled with red badge
Frontend: Toast shows 'Order marked as cancelled' message
Frontend: Cancelled orders show read-only status badge (no dropdown)
Frontend: Cancelled orders display cancellation_reason truncated below badge
Frontend: Edit button hidden for cancelled orders
Frontend: Cancelled order rows have red background styling (bg-red-50/50 opacity-75)
Frontend: Status filter includes 'Cancelled' option
Frontend: Filtering by Cancelled status shows only cancelled orders
critical_code_review_comments: Minor React hydration warning in console - <span> elements inside <tbody>/<tr> - known cosmetic issue from previous iteration
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Cancel_Customer_* orders for backend testing and TEST_UI_Cancel_Test for UI testing
